Fine-tuning experimental results reveal that LayoutPointer outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, improving F1 scores by 5.68% over GeoLayoutLM and 5.71% over LayoutLMv3 for the RE task on FUNSD and XFUND, respectively, and significantly improving by 30.29% over LayoutLMv3 on MLFUD.
